create_issue_link.description: Create an issue link between two issues. Use this for a new resource or action; choose the corresponding update or edit tool when the resource already exists. It changes remote GitLab state and requires the necessary project or group permission; GitLab returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors instead of silently applying an invalid request. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of a project's issue

link_type.description: The type of the relation, defaults to relates_to

target_issue_iid.description: The internal ID of a target project's issue

target_project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of a target project
